name: Cask of Merlot
summary: In Stormwind, Cask of Merlot helps supply Lakeshire as Blackrock orcs sever its trade routes.

sections.title: A Taste of the Capital
sections.body: Galina Winery makes its merlot in the heart of the kingdom. Its cellars lie along the canals by Stormwind's Trade District. Winemaker Roberto Pupellyverbos tends the vintages for the capital's refined tastes. Unlike Duskwood moonshine or Elwynn spirits, this wine bears the craft of human vintners working within the city's walls.

sections.title: Restocking Lakeshire
sections.body: When the Blackrock clan invaded the Redridge Mountains, supply routes failed and Lakeshire lost its usual merchant shipments. The locals were left parched and frightened. So Barkeep Daniels sends willing couriers across the kingdom to refill his tavern's cellars. By Lake Everstill, defenders and refugees can wash down their rations with the cask's gentle wine.

faq.q: Where can I find a Cask of Merlot?
faq.answer: Roberto Pupellyverbos sells the Cask of Merlot inside the Galina Winery. The winery lies along the canals at the edge of Stormwind City's Trade District.

faq.q: Why does Barkeep Daniels need this wine?
faq.answer: The Blackrock orc invasion of Redridge has cut off Lakeshire's regular shipments, and Barkeep Daniels is nearly out of alcohol. He sends adventurers across southern Azeroth to find regional specialties and keep his patrons satisfied.

faq.q: What other drinks are collected alongside the Merlot?
faq.answer: Daniels also asks for a skin of Sweet Rum from Goldshire, a bottle of Moonshine from Darkshire, and a keg of Thunderbrew Lager from Grimbooze Thunderbrew in the hills of Westfall.

faq.q: Is the Galina Winery in danger?
faq.answer: The Galina Winery is safe behind Stormwind City's stone ramparts. Bandits and orc raids trouble outlying lands such as Westfall and Redridge, while trade and winemaking continue in the capital's canal district.

angles.text: For the Alliance, fetching the cask shows the divide between Stormwind's secure canal district and Redridge's towns under siege.
